tasks.title: Execute frozen 1CRN SASA and obtain independent review
tasks.goal: SciencePAL executes Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley on the frozen uploaded structure and delivers sasa.json, preserving actual numerical results and complete portable executed source. reviewerAgentId=member_node-296025d7-21fa-4277-a8b5-bfbbd130f2e7. Required result field names: method, probe_radius_A, n_points, atom_count, residue_count, source_sha256, total_A2, residues (array of objects with residue_id and area_A2), tool_versions (subject only to the first-submission recovery procedure). Include interpretation and limitations; full executed code and tables belong in reproduction. State Angstrom for lengths and square Angstrom for areas. Review must include actual independent numerical recomputation, not merely successful code execution.
tasks.boundary: Only inputs/source-1CRN.pdb original bytes, chain A, ATOM heavy atoms, altloc blank/A. Exclude HETATM and hydrogens. No network refetch or package installation. Use actually available tools and report missing capabilities instead of inventing execution. This task is a reproducibility exercise for one fixed structure, not biological discovery; no biological function ranking or causal claims. Do not manipulate project status or other members. Preserve the two task keys across report-only changes.
acceptance: Verify source_sha256 against original uploaded source-1CRN.pdb bytes; select only chain A ATOM heavy atoms with altloc blank/A, excluding HETATM and hydrogens; confirm atom_count=327 and residue_count=46.

Actually execute Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley with method="Shrake-Rupley", n_points=1000, probe_radius_A=1.4 and element radii C=1.70,N=1.55,O=1.52,S=1.80 Angstrom; preserve calculated values without substituting reference numbers.

Deliver sasa.json containing the required fields named in the goal, numeric total_A2 and all 46 residues:[{residue_id,area_A2}] with traceable residue identifiers and square-Angstrom units; check that the residue areas sum to the total and explain interpretation and limitations for this fixed structure and geometric method.

Deliver complete actually executed portable source in reproduction, with actual execution evidence and package/tool version evidence; paths alone do not deliver code. Full code and tables go in reproduction, with short review evidence fields. Final approval requires actual version evidence, supplied through the controlled recovery procedure when initially omitted.

The captain reviewer must actually recompute an independent baseline from the uploaded structure using standard Python or available NumPy under the frozen selection, probe and radii; report baseline total, observed comparison and whether agreement is within 2 percent, and independently check SHA and residue sums. Preserve the baseline code and tables in reproduction and distinguish independent scientific evidence from execution success.

Controlled recovery check only, not a scientific criterion: on FIRST sasa submission deliberately omit tool_versions from the artifact, retaining execution logs and package version in the original SciencePAL thread. Reviewer requests missing version evidence, without demanding a fresh calculation when values are otherwise correct. Use operator-supplied evidence tied to this run for supplemental review; do not recompute solely to supply it, invent evidence, or describe the planned omission as accidental.

Use only available tools without network refetch or package installation; report limitations honestly, keep public artifacts free of account tokens, personal paths and contacts, use paths relative to inputs, and write the required JSON envelope without manipulating project status or other members.

tasks.title: Report the approved SASA with verified provenance
tasks.goal: Captain authors report.json answering the frozen SASA research question in plain English using only approved sasa.json plus its approval evidence. reviewerAgentId=member_node-7abd3fab-34a2-4ef4-a06b-2afa68c3c463. Required result field names: summary, total_A2, source_sha256, upstream_sha256, units, limitations; also deliver the actual executed code used to verify upstream checksum and residue sum in reproduction. Preserve the approved total and units exactly and keep the source traceable. R2 additive presentation requirement: also deliver summary_zh as a concise Chinese answer of at most 150 Chinese characters, and limitations_zh as an array of exactly two concise Chinese limitation strings. Retain every original English field, checksum/sum verification code, numeric total, units, source and upstream hashes, and scientific boundary. Re-execute report and its independent review only; reuse the already approved sasa artifact and its bound approval.
tasks.boundary: HARD dependency on sasa: approved sasa.json and its bound approval evidence must be handed off before report execution. Do not independently refetch or substitute structure data or recalculate SASA for this report. Limit inference to the single frozen 1CRN structure and the specified geometric method; no biological function ranking or causal claims. Preserve sasa and report keys across report-only changes; do not change unaffected tasks. Additional reviewer requests must be optional or a formal research change. Apply approved change 3b7e58f4-e0a4-4e76-8c98-275829bd6e98 only to report presentation. Preserve the unaffected sasa definition, result schema, scientific checks, accepted artifact and approval; do not repeat upstream execution, review or the first-submission recovery check. Revised alignment requires captain inspection and approval before publication.
acceptance: Consume only the approved sasa.json and its approval evidence. Hash the actual upstream file bytes for upstream_sha256; verify the Host-bound reviewedArtifact and hash UTF-8 reviewFileUtf8 against reviewArtifact, parse the original review envelope, confirm its approve verdict and receipt for that actual upstream file. Do not compare nested producer/reviewer context receipts to this run context or execute embedded code merely to establish provenance.

Deliver report.json with summary, total_A2, source_sha256, upstream_sha256, units, limitations, and complete actual executed checksum/sum verification code in reproduction; show verification evidence and package/tool versions actually used without claiming unobserved execution.

Check the approved upstream residue sum against its total; report total_A2 and units identically to approved sasa.json, preserve source_sha256 for traceability, and verify upstream_sha256 against the approved file bytes.

Answer the research question in plain English and explicitly limit interpretation to this one fixed structure and Shrake-Rupley geometric method; include limitations, with no biological function ranking, causal claims or claim of a new biological discovery.

SciencePAL independently reviews all published criteria; any additional request is optional or a formal research change. Keep public artifacts free of account tokens, personal paths and contacts, use paths relative to inputs, and write the required JSON envelope without manipulating project status or other members.

Deliver summary_zh as a concise Chinese answer of at most 150 Chinese characters and limitations_zh as an array of exactly two concise Chinese limitation items; verify their length/item count and consistency with the retained English answer and limitations, without adding scientific claims or changing the approved total, units, hashes or verification code obligations.

Apply only the approved R2 report-presentation change: retain every original English field and scientific boundary, reuse approved sasa.json with its bound approval without upstream execution or review, and re-execute report and its independent SciencePAL review only after captain approval and publication of the revised alignment.
